attchmntText: Kridhan Infra Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Kridhan Infra Limited filed a statement of deviation or variation in the utilization of funds raised for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company raised Rs. 41,60,00,000 through public issues. The report confirms there is no deviation or variation in the use of funds. Funds were utilized for repayment of debt and other financial liabilities, investment in subsidiaries, associates and joint ventures, and general corporate purpose. The total amount utilized as of the reporting date is Rs. 15,50,13,750. The monitoring agency is not applicable. Comments from the audit committee and auditors are none. The statement was submitted by Mr. Mithlesh Jaiswal, Director and CFO, with DIN number 07946915.

attchmntText: Kridhan Infra Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Kridhan Infra Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 123.18 lakhs, with a profit before tax of 3.03 lakhs and earnings per share of 0.00 rupees. Consolidated revenue from operations was 204.91 lakhs, with a profit before tax of 14.97 lakhs and earnings per share of 0.01 rupees. The company operates in a single business segment. The subsidiary Readymade Steel Singapore Pte. Ltd. is under liquidation and is excluded from consolidated results. The board meeting commenced at 6.30 pm and concluded at 7.30 pm.
